newsitem.title: UK: UK shares seen eyeing US jobs data in coming week.
newsitem.headline: UK shares seen eyeing US jobs data in coming week.

text.p: UK shares are likely to be on edge next week, awaiting Friday's monthly U.S. employment report which could either confirm or kill the growing interest rate optimism that has boosted markets in recent weeks.
"We could see more pressure on the downside with the U.S. payroll figures coming up to haunt us," said Andy Hartwill, strategist at brokerage SG Strauss Turnbull.
In the past week UK stocks took heart from the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates unchanged, possibly opening the way to further rate cuts in continental Europe.
